_doc: Complexity ladder L0 (planar 180-degree bend from the geometry engine (U-bend calibre 27.4/26.0/24.4 mm, ascending 50 mm, arch radius 40.4 mm, descending 200 mm)); the U-bend gallery mesh configuration with 18 cells across the span. Invoke with: python run_patient.py ladder_L0 --config cases_input/ladder_L0/config_physio_mid_span18.json Physiological-waveform series (24 November 2026): physio_inflow.csv, half-sine ejection over 0.3 s (peak 20.94 L/min at 0.150 s, mean 5.00 L/min), zero inflow for the rest of the 0.8 s cycle; outlet backflow damping betaT 0.3 and betaN 0.3 on every level (the fine Ladder 3 mesh of the first series collapsed with betaN 0).

geometry._doc: reference_radius_strategy='max' (default) anchors the background-mesh sizing to the largest vessel. For the single-tube ubend this is the inlet (27.4 mm). On a multi-branch aorta, switch to 'min' if you need every branch resolved to the cells_across_span target.
